data.reasoning: The package is a standard -bin package that downloads prebuilt binaries from the official upstream GitHub repository with pinned SHA-256 checksums. The PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO contain no malicious code, dynamic fetching, or execution of unverified content. The disagreement was solely due to a transient API error in the qwen model.
data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an 'inconclusive' verdict because it encountered an HTTP 400 API error while auditing the .SRCINFO file. The deepseek model successfully audited both files and correctly identified the package as safe. Per the rules, the tool error in qwen carries no verdict signal.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error, resulting in an incomplete review.
learnings: Implement retry logic or graceful degradation for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) so that a single file failure doesn't unnecessarily force an inconclusive verdict when the critical PKGBUILD is already deemed safe.
